title: Claude Code - Governance & Audit

list.name: environment
list.label: Environment
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT environment FROM traces ORDER BY environment

list.name: user
list.label: User
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT user_id FROM traces WHERE user_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY user_id

panels.title: CURRENT THREAT LEVEL
panels.description: Composite threat level: destructive×3 + sensitive×2 + secret_write×5

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  multiIf(
    (destructive * 3 + suspicious * 2 + secret_writes * 5) > 10, 3,
    (destructive * 3 + suspicious * 2 + secret_writes * 5) > 3, 2,
    (destructive * 3 + suspicious * 2 + secret_writes * 5) > 0, 1,
    0
  ) AS threat_level_int,
  destructive,
  suspicious,
  secret_writes
FROM (
  SELECT
    countIf(name = 'Tool: Bash' AND
            (positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'rm -rf') > 0
             OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'sudo rm') > 0)) AS destructive,
    countIf(name = 'Tool: Read' AND
            (JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.ssh/%'
             OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.env%')) AS suspicious,
    countIf(name IN ('Tool: Edit', 'Tool: Write') AND
            (positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(input, ''), 'api_key') > 0
             OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(input, ''), 'aws_secret') > 0
             OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(input, ''), 'private_key') > 0)) AS secret_writes
  FROM observations_eff
  WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
)

options.content:
**Incident-driven query entry point** — when sec receives an event to investigate, start here:

1. Use the top **variable filters** to pick `$user` (who) / `$environment` (which machine).
2. Adjust the **time window** (top-right) to the incident period.
3. Below: **Activity Timeline** for the timeline, **Recent Destructive Ops** for the high-risk actions.
4. Drill into **Row 2 (High-risk Bash/Edit)** for the specific commands.
5. Drill into **Row 3 (Anti-Patterns)** for abnormal behavior.

> All tables have **inspect mode** enabled — click a row to view the full raw content.

panels.title: Total Sessions (window)
panels.description: Distinct sessions in window — denominator for many ratios on this dashboard.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
FROM traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND session_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)

panels.title: High-Risk Operations (Bash + Write + Edit)
panels.description: Bash + Write + Edit total count

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS ops FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
  AND name IN ('Tool: Bash', 'Tool: Write', 'Tool: Edit')
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)

panels.title: Destructive Ops (extended keywords)
panels.description: Hit count for keywords: rm/sudo/chmod/chown/mkfs/dd/drop/truncate/>etc/iptables/systemctl/kill-9/curl|sh etc.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS destructive
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
  AND name = 'Tool: Bash'
  AND (positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'rm -rf') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'rm -fr') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'sudo rm') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'chmod 777') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'chmod -R 777') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'chown -R') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'mkfs') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'dd if=') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'drop table') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'drop database') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'truncate ') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), '> /etc/') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'iptables ') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'systemctl stop') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'systemctl disable') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'kill -9') > 0
    OR (positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'curl ') > 0
        AND positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), ' | sh') > 0)
    OR (positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'wget ') > 0
        AND positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), ' | sh') > 0))
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)

panels.title: Outbound Web Calls
panels.description: Bash + Tool calls reaching the public internet (WebFetch, WebSearch, curl, wget). Sustained high values are sec-relevant.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS web_calls
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
  AND name IN ('Tool: WebFetch', 'Tool: WebSearch')
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)

panels.title: Active Users (window)
panels.description: Distinct active users in window. Helps scope which users to investigate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT user_id) AS users
FROM traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)

panels.title: Reject Rate (signal)
panels.description: High reject can mean either Claude is offering unreliable suggestions (sec-relevant) or a very cautious user (not a problem). Drill into the 'Mass-rejecter' table to distinguish.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject')) * 100.0 /
       nullIf(sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept') +
                  JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject')), 0), 2) AS reject_pct
FROM traces WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)

panels.title: Activity Timeline (by tool category)
panels.description: Tool calls stacked by category. bash=orange (disk-write risk), write=red (file modify), web=purple (outbound), read=blue (info gathering), other=green. Bursts are incident signals.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time,
  multiIf(
    name = 'Tool: Bash', 'bash',
    name IN ('Tool: Edit', 'Tool: Write'), 'write',
    name IN ('Tool: WebFetch', 'Tool: WebSearch'), 'web',
    name = 'Tool: Read', 'read',
    'other'
  ) AS category,
  count(*) AS calls
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time) AND name LIKE 'Tool: %'
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY time, category
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Recent Destructive Ops
panels.description: Hits on dangerous keywords. Click a row to expand the full command (inspect is enabled).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(o.start_time) AS at,
  t.user_id AS user,
  multiIf(
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'rm -rf') > 0
      OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'rm -fr') > 0, 'rm -rf',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'sudo rm') > 0, 'sudo rm',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'chmod 777') > 0, 'chmod 777',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'chown -R') > 0, 'chown -R',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'mkfs') > 0, 'mkfs',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'dd if=') > 0, 'dd if=',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'drop table') > 0, 'drop table',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'drop database') > 0, 'drop database',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'truncate ') > 0, 'truncate',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), '> /etc/') > 0, '> /etc/',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'iptables ') > 0, 'iptables',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'systemctl stop') > 0, 'systemctl stop',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'systemctl disable') > 0, 'systemctl disable',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'kill -9') > 0, 'kill -9',
    'curl|wget|sh'
  ) AS keyword,
  substring(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 1, 200) AS command,
  toString(t.session_id) AS session_id
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND o.name = 'Tool: Bash'
  AND (positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'rm -rf') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'rm -fr') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'sudo rm') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'chmod 777') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'chown -R') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'mkfs') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'dd if=') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'drop table') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'drop database') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'truncate ') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), '> /etc/') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'iptables ') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'systemctl stop') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'systemctl disable') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'kill -9') > 0)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
ORDER BY o.start_time DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: High-Risk User Score (composite risk score)
panels.description: Scoring formula: destructive×10 + sensitive_reads×8 + errors×1. Surfaces sec-priority users at a glance.

targets.rawSql:
WITH user_risk AS (
  SELECT
    t.user_id AS user,
    countIf(o.name = 'Tool: Bash' AND positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'rm -rf') > 0) AS destructive_cmds,
    countIf(o.name = 'Tool: Read' AND
            (JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.ssh/%'
             OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.env%'
             OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%credential%'
             OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%token%'
             OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.aws/%')) AS sensitive_reads,
    countIf(o.name IN ('Tool: WebFetch', 'Tool: WebSearch')) AS web_calls,
    countIf(o.level = 'ERROR') AS errors,
    countIf(o.name = 'Tool: Bash') AS bash_total
  FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
    AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
  GROUP BY user
)
SELECT
  user,
  destructive_cmds * 10 + sensitive_reads * 8 + errors * 1 AS risk_score,
  destructive_cmds,
  sensitive_reads,
  web_calls,
  errors,
  bash_total
FROM user_risk
WHERE risk_score > 0
ORDER BY risk_score DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Bash Commands Top 100 (raw data)
panels.description: Last 100 Bash commands, raw. **Tip**: use browser Ctrl+F to search 'rm', 'sudo', 'curl' etc., or use the categorized 'Dangerous Keyword Hits' table above.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(o.start_time) AS at,
  t.user_id AS user,
  substring(JSONExtractString(o.input, 'command'), 1, 500) AS command
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND o.name = 'Tool: Bash'
  AND JSONExtractString(o.input, 'command') != ''
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
ORDER BY o.start_time DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Dangerous Keyword Hits (rm/sudo/chmod/dd/mkfs/drop/truncate/curl)
panels.description: Categorized list of suspicious commands. Each row is one execution with user / time / command snippet context.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(start_time) AS at,
  user_id AS user,
  multiIf(
    positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'rm -rf') > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'rm -fr') > 0, 'rm -rf',
    positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'sudo rm') > 0, 'sudo rm',
    positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'chmod 777') > 0, 'chmod 777',
    positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'mkfs') > 0, 'mkfs',
    positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'dd if=') > 0, 'dd if=',
    positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'drop table') > 0, 'drop table',
    positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'drop database') > 0, 'drop database',
    positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'truncate ') > 0, 'truncate',
    positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'curl ') > 0 AND positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, ' | sh') > 0, 'curl|sh',
    positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'wget ') > 0 AND positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, ' | sh') > 0, 'wget|sh',
    'other'
  ) AS keyword,
  substring(cmd, 1, 300) AS command_preview
FROM (
  SELECT o.start_time AS start_time, t.user_id AS user_id,
    JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command') AS cmd
  FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.name = 'Tool: Bash'
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
)
WHERE positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'rm -rf') > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'rm -fr') > 0
   OR positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'sudo rm') > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'chmod 777') > 0
   OR positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'mkfs') > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'dd if=') > 0
   OR positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'drop table') > 0 OR positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'drop database') > 0
   OR positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'truncate ') > 0
   OR (positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'curl ') > 0 AND positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, ' | sh') > 0)
   OR (positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, 'wget ') > 0 AND positionCaseInsensitive(cmd, ' | sh') > 0)
ORDER BY start_time DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Edit / Write File Paths
panels.description: All file-write operations. Click the file_path column to inspect.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(o.start_time) AS at,
  t.user_id AS user,
  o.name AS tool,
  JSONExtractString(o.input, 'file_path') AS file_path
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND o.name IN ('Tool: Edit', 'Tool: Write')
  AND JSONExtractString(o.input, 'file_path') != ''
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
ORDER BY o.start_time DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Write Path Directory Distribution
panels.description: Heat of write-operation directory prefixes. Sec can decide which paths are sensitive based on the high-write list.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  splitByChar('/', JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path'))[2] AS root_dir,
  splitByChar('/', JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path'))[3] AS sub_dir,
  count(*) AS writes,
  count(DISTINCT t.user_id) AS users
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND o.name IN ('Tool: Edit', 'Tool: Write')
  AND JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '/%'
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
GROUP BY root_dir, sub_dir
ORDER BY writes DESC
LIMIT 30

panels.title: Read Tool Monitoring (sensitive-file tagging)
panels.description: Read is the exfiltration surface: SSH key / .env / credential / token / .pem / aws / kube config etc. flagged red automatically. Click a user to jump to the full Audit Trail.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(o.start_time) AS at,
  t.user_id AS user,
  JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') AS file_path,
  case
    when JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.ssh/%' then 'SSH_KEYS'
    when JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.env%' then 'ENV_FILE'
    when JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%credential%' then 'CREDENTIAL'
    when JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/etc/passwd%' then 'PASSWD'
    when JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/etc/shadow%' then 'SHADOW'
    when JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%token%' then 'TOKEN'
    when JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%secret%' then 'SECRET'
    when JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%.pem' then 'CERT_PEM'
    when JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.aws/%' then 'AWS_CREDS'
    when JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%.kube/config' then 'KUBE_CONFIG'
    else 'normal'
  end AS sensitivity
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND o.name = 'Tool: Read'
  AND JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') != ''
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
ORDER BY case when sensitivity = 'normal' then 1 else 0 end, o.start_time DESC
LIMIT 100

options.content:
- **Mass-rejecter**: user reject rate > 30% — either Claude is systematically giving bad suggestions, or the user uses Claude without trusting it (training needed).
- **All-reject session**: zero accepts across the entire session — the interaction failed end-to-end, possibly a prompt-injection test or a tool misconfiguration.
- **Continued after error**: user kept going after a tool error without changing approach — possibly a script batch run or attention lapse.

panels.title: Mass-rejecter (high reject rate)
panels.description: Users whose accept/(accept+reject) ratio is below 30%. Either Claude is offering bad suggestions (sec-relevant), or the user is highly cautious — drill in to distinguish.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  user_id AS user,
  sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) AS accepts,
  sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject')) AS rejects,
  round(sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject')) * 100.0 /
        nullIf(sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept') +
                   JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject')), 0), 1) AS reject_rate_pct,
  count(DISTINCT session_id) AS sessions
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND metadata['tool_decisions'] != ''
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
GROUP BY user
HAVING (accepts + rejects) >= 5
ORDER BY reject_rate_pct DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: All-Reject Sessions (entire session, 0 accepts)
panels.description: User accepted no suggestion in the entire session. Could be a prompt-injection test or a severe trust crisis.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  user_id AS user,
  toString(session_id) AS session_id,
  sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'accept')) AS accepts,
  sum(JSONExtractInt(metadata['tool_decisions'], 'reject')) AS rejects,
  count(*) AS turns,
  toString(min(timestamp)) AS started,
  toString(max(timestamp)) AS ended
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND session_id IS NOT NULL
  AND metadata['tool_decisions'] != ''
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
GROUP BY user, session_id
HAVING accepts = 0 AND rejects > 0
ORDER BY rejects DESC
LIMIT 30

panels.title: Error-Dense Sessions (>=3 errors in single session)
panels.description: 3+ errors accumulated in a single session. Could be prompt-injection attempt or a user pushing back against bad suggestions.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  t.user_id AS user,
  toString(t.session_id) AS session_id,
  count(*) AS errors,
  toString(min(o.start_time)) AS first_error,
  toString(max(o.start_time)) AS last_error,
  arrayStringConcat(arrayDistinct(arrayFlatten(groupArray(o.tool_call_names))), ', ') AS tools_involved
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.level = 'ERROR'
  AND t.session_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
GROUP BY user, session_id
HAVING errors >= 3
ORDER BY errors DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Outbound access and code leakage are key compliance focus

options.content:
**WebFetch / WebSearch is the primary exfiltration surface**: every external URL the user pointed Claude at lands here.
- **WebFetch outbound domains**: aggregated to second-level domains — which sites are hit most.
- **WebFetch URL list**: raw data — sec to scan manually.
- **Code snippets leaving via prompts**: user-prompt length distribution + long-prompt list — long prompts often contain large code blocks.

panels.title: WebFetch / WebSearch Outbound Domains
panels.description: Second-level domains for outbound requests. Any unexpected domain warrants sec attention.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  domain,
  count(*) AS calls,
  count(DISTINCT t.user_id) AS users,
  toString(min(o.start_time)) AS first_seen,
  toString(max(o.start_time)) AS last_seen
FROM (
  SELECT o.start_time, o.trace_id,
    domainWithoutWWW(JSONExtractString(o.input, 'url')) AS domain
  FROM observations_eff o
  WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
    AND o.name = 'Tool: WebFetch'
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
) o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE domain != ''
GROUP BY domain
ORDER BY calls DESC
LIMIT 30

panels.title: WebFetch URL Raw (last 50)
panels.description: Full URL + the prompt the user passed to fetch. Click a row to expand the full content.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(o.start_time) AS at,
  t.user_id AS user,
  JSONExtractString(o.input, 'url') AS url,
  substring(JSONExtractString(o.input, 'prompt'), 1, 200) AS prompt_preview
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND o.name = 'Tool: WebFetch'
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
ORDER BY o.start_time DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Prompt Length Distribution (code-leakage risk)
panels.description: User prompt length buckets. very_long (>=2000) usually contains long code blocks → code-leakage risk. **Note**: current telemetry caps prompt length at 136 chars, so very_long never fires (telemetry limitation).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toDate(timestamp) AS time,
  countIf(length(metadata['user_text']) < 100) AS short,
  countIf(length(metadata['user_text']) >= 100 AND length(metadata['user_text']) < 500) AS medium,
  countIf(length(metadata['user_text']) >= 500 AND length(metadata['user_text']) < 2000) AS long_,
  countIf(length(metadata['user_text']) >= 2000) AS very_long
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND metadata['user_text'] != ''
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Long Prompts (>= 100 chars)
panels.description: List of very long prompts — sec self-check for sensitive code / config / secrets. Threshold lowered to 100 chars to match current telemetry's actual length cap.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(timestamp) AS at,
  user_id AS user,
  length(metadata['user_text']) AS prompt_length,
  substring(metadata['user_text'], 1, 300) AS prompt_preview
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND length(metadata['user_text']) >= 100
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
ORDER BY prompt_length DESC
LIMIT 30

panels.title: Off-Hours / Late-Night Activity
panels.description: Working hours (9-18) / late night (22-6) / edge (6-9, 18-22). High late_night = possible account compromise or automated script.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toDate(start_time) AS time,
  countIf(toHour(start_time) >= 9 AND toHour(start_time) < 18) AS work_hours,
  countIf(toHour(start_time) >= 22 OR toHour(start_time) < 6) AS late_night,
  countIf((toHour(start_time) >= 18 AND toHour(start_time) < 22)
       OR (toHour(start_time) >= 6 AND toHour(start_time) < 9)) AS off_hours
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
  AND name LIKE 'Tool: %'
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Privilege Operations (sudo/su/chown/chmod)
panels.description: Privilege-escalation ops. Lots of sudo = users running root tasks; audit for compliance.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(o.start_time) AS at,
  t.user_id AS user,
  multiIf(
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(^|[ ;|&]+)sudo\s') > 0, 'sudo',
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(^|[ ;|&]+)su\s+-') > 0, 'su',
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(^|[ ;|&]+)chown\s') > 0, 'chown',
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(^|[ ;|&]+)chmod\s') > 0, 'chmod',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'setuid') > 0, 'setuid',
    'other'
  ) AS op,
  substring(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 1, 250) AS command
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.name = 'Tool: Bash'
  AND (
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), '(^|[ ;|&]+)sudo\s') > 0
    OR match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), '(^|[ ;|&]+)su\s+-') > 0
    OR match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), '(^|[ ;|&]+)chown\s') > 0
    OR match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), '(^|[ ;|&]+)chmod\s') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'setuid') > 0
  )
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
ORDER BY o.start_time DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Network Operations (curl/wget/ssh/scp/...)
panels.description: Network commands within Bash. View together with WebFetch domains to surface all outbound activity.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(o.start_time) AS at,
  t.user_id AS user,
  multiIf(
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(^|[ ;|&]+)curl\s') > 0, 'curl',
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(^|[ ;|&]+)wget\s') > 0, 'wget',
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(^|[ ;|&]+)nc\s') > 0, 'netcat',
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(^|[ ;|&]+)ssh\s') > 0, 'ssh',
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(^|[ ;|&]+)scp\s') > 0, 'scp',
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(^|[ ;|&]+)rsync\s') > 0, 'rsync',
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(^|[ ;|&]+)ftp\s') > 0, 'ftp',
    'other'
  ) AS net_tool,
  substring(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 1, 250) AS command
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.name = 'Tool: Bash'
  AND match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
            '(^|[ ;|&]+)(curl|wget|nc|ssh|scp|rsync|ftp)\s') > 0
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))

LIMIT 100

panels.title: Package Installations (supply-chain risk)
panels.description: Package install commands like npm/pip/apt. Primary supply-chain attack surface — sec should audit every entry.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(o.start_time) AS at,
  t.user_id AS user,
  multiIf(
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'npm install ') > 0
      OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'npm i ') > 0, 'npm',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'pip install') > 0, 'pip',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'apt install') > 0
      OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'apt-get install') > 0, 'apt',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'yum install') > 0, 'yum',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'brew install') > 0, 'brew',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'gem install') > 0, 'gem',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'cargo install') > 0, 'cargo',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'go install') > 0, 'go',
    'other'
  ) AS pkg_mgr,
  substring(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 1, 250) AS command
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.name = 'Tool: Bash'
  AND (positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'npm install') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'npm i ') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'pip install') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'apt install') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'apt-get install') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'yum install') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'brew install') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'gem install') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'cargo install') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'go install') > 0)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
ORDER BY o.start_time DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Git Operations (code movement audit)
panels.description: git clone / push / remote add etc. Suspicious: push to a non-corporate remote = code leakage.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(o.start_time) AS at,
  t.user_id AS user,
  multiIf(
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'git clone') > 0, 'clone',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'git push') > 0, 'push',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'git remote add') > 0, 'remote_add',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'git config') > 0, 'config',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'git fetch') > 0, 'fetch',
    positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'git submodule') > 0, 'submodule',
    'other_git'
  ) AS git_op,
  substring(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 1, 250) AS command
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.name = 'Tool: Bash'
  AND positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'git ') > 0
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
ORDER BY o.start_time DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Encoded / Obfuscated Commands (hidden intent)
panels.description: Suspicious command shapes: base64/xxd decode piped to a shell, eval, echo|sh, or python -c with exec/import/eval payload. Word-boundary regex to keep false positives low.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(o.start_time) AS at,
  t.user_id AS user,
  multiIf(
    -- base64 decode piped to a shell = high-confidence obfuscation
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(?i)base64\s+(-d|--decode)') > 0
      AND match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
                '\|\s*(sh|bash|zsh)\b') > 0, 'base64_pipe_sh',
    -- xxd -r piped to sh
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(?i)xxd\s+-r') > 0
      AND match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
                '\|\s*(sh|bash|zsh)\b') > 0, 'xxd_pipe_sh',
    -- echo "..." | sh / bash
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(?i)echo\s+(["''][^"'']+["'']|\S+)\s*\|\s*(sh|bash)\b') > 0, 'echo_pipe_sh',
    -- bare eval as a command (word boundary before, space after)
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(^|[ ;|&]+)eval\s') > 0, 'eval',
    -- python -c with suspicious payload markers
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(?i)python3?\s+-c\s+["''].*(exec|__import__|eval|base64).*["'']') > 0, 'python_c_suspicious',
    -- standalone base64 decode (lower priority — common in dev workflows)
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(?i)base64\s+(-d|--decode)') > 0, 'base64_decode',
    'other'
  ) AS kind,
  substring(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 1, 250) AS command
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time) AND o.name = 'Tool: Bash'
  AND (
    match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
          '(?i)base64\s+(-d|--decode)') > 0
    OR match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
             '(^|[ ;|&]+)eval\s') > 0
    OR match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
             '(?i)xxd\s+-r') > 0
    OR match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
             '(?i)echo\s+\S+\s*\|\s*(sh|bash)\b') > 0
    OR match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'),
             '(?i)python3?\s+-c') > 0
  )
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
ORDER BY at DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Outbound Network Volume Trend
panels.description: Total outbound request trend (WebFetch + WebSearch + bash curl/wget). Sudden spike = anomaly.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeInterval(start_time) AS time,
  countIf(name = 'Tool: WebFetch') AS web_fetch,
  countIf(name = 'Tool: WebSearch') AS web_search,
  countIf(name = 'Tool: Bash' AND
          (positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'curl ') > 0
           OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'wget ') > 0)) AS bash_outbound
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Newly Observed Domains (24h)
panels.description: WebFetch domains first seen in the last 24 h (not seen in the prior 30 d). Anything unexpected = investigation signal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  domainWithoutWWW(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'url')) AS domain,
  min(start_time) AS first_seen,
  max(start_time) AS last_seen,
  count() AS total_calls
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
  AND name = 'Tool: WebFetch'
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY domain
HAVING domain != '' AND first_seen >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
ORDER BY first_seen DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: Multi-Sensitive File Access (cross-category sensitive reads)
panels.description: Users accessing multiple sensitive resource categories. distinct_categories >= 2 = high risk.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  t.user_id AS user,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.ssh/%') AS ssh_reads,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.env%') AS env_reads,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%credential%') AS credential_reads,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%token%') AS token_reads,
  countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.aws/%') AS aws_reads,
  (countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.ssh/%') > 0) +
  (countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.env%') > 0) +
  (countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%credential%') > 0) +
  (countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%token%') > 0) +
  (countIf(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.aws/%') > 0) AS distinct_categories
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND o.name = 'Tool: Read'
  AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY user
HAVING distinct_categories >= 1
ORDER BY distinct_categories DESC, ssh_reads + env_reads + credential_reads DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Daily Risk Trend (destructive / sudo / outbound)
panels.description: Daily trend: destructive / sudo / outbound. Spikes = investigate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toDate(start_time) AS time,
  countIf(positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'rm -rf') > 0
       OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'sudo rm') > 0) AS destructive,
  countIf(positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input, '{}'), 'command'), 'sudo ') > 0) AS sudo_total,
  countIf(name IN ('Tool: WebFetch', 'Tool: WebSearch')) AS outbound
FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Threat Events — Hourly Breakdown
panels.description: Hourly count of distinct threat-class events: destructive ops, secret writes, sudo, outbound network ops. Use to localize spikes within a day.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfHour(o.start_time) AS time,
  countIf(o.name='Tool: Bash' AND
          (positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input,'{}'),'command'),'rm -rf')>0
           OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input,'{}'),'command'),'mkfs')>0
           OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input,'{}'),'command'),'sudo rm')>0)) AS destructive,
  countIf(o.name='Tool: Bash' AND
          match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input,'{}'),'command'),'(^|[ ;|&]+)sudo\s')>0) AS sudo_ops,
  countIf(o.name='Tool: Bash' AND
          match(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input,'{}'),'command'),'(^|[ ;|&]+)(curl|wget)\s')>0) AS outbound,
  countIf(o.name IN ('Tool: Edit','Tool: Write','Tool: MultiEdit') AND
          (match(coalesce(o.input,''),'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}')
           OR match(coalesce(o.input,''),'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}')
           OR match(coalesce(o.input,''),'AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}'))) AS secret_writes,
  countIf(o.level='ERROR' AND position(coalesce(o.status_message,''),'Permission denied')>0) AS denials
FROM observations_eff o
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY time
ORDER BY time

panels.title: Sub-agent Invocations Audit
panels.description: Sub-agent call details. Sub-agents carry long contexts and easily become a privilege-amplification surface.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(o.start_time) AS at,
  t.user_id AS user,
  o.name AS agent_name,
  substring(coalesce(o.input, ''), 1, 200) AS input_preview,
  o.level AS level,
  toString(o.id) AS observation_id
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND has(o.tool_call_names, 'Agent')
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
ORDER BY o.start_time DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Permission Denied Errors (privilege-escalation signal)
panels.description: Permission-denied errors — users trying actions they lack permission for; many in a row = privilege probing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(o.start_time) AS at,
  t.user_id AS user,
  o.name AS tool,
  substring(coalesce(o.status_message, ''), 1, 200) AS error_msg,
  toString(t.session_id) AS session_id
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND o.level = 'ERROR'
  AND coalesce(o.status_message, '') NOT IN ('User rejected tool use')
  AND positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(o.status_message, ''), 'permission denied') > 0
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
ORDER BY o.start_time DESC
LIMIT 30

panels.title: Destructive Ops
panels.description: Distinct destructive ops occurrences in the time window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS v FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
  AND name='Tool: Bash'
  AND (positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input,'{}'),'command'),'rm -rf')>0
       OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input,'{}'),'command'),'mkfs')>0
       OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input,'{}'),'command'),'dd if=')>0
       OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(input,'{}'),'command'),'sudo rm')>0)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)

panels.title: Secret Writes
panels.description: Distinct secret writes occurrences in the time window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS v FROM observations_eff
WHERE $__timeFilter(start_time)
  AND name IN ('Tool: Edit','Tool: Write','Tool: MultiEdit')
  AND (match(coalesce(input,''), 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}')
       OR match(coalesce(input,''), 'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}')
       OR match(coalesce(input,''), 'AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}')
       OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(input,''),'BEGIN RSA PRIVATE')>0
       OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(input,''),'BEGIN OPENSSH')>0)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)

panels.title: Exfil Sessions
panels.description: Distinct exfil sessions occurrences in the time window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(DISTINCT t.session_id) AS v
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id=t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND t.session_id IN (
    SELECT t2.session_id FROM observations_eff o2 INNER JOIN traces t2 ON o2.trace_id=t2.id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(o2.start_time)
      AND o2.name='Tool: Read'
      AND (JSONExtractString(coalesce(o2.input,'{}'),'file_path') LIKE '%/.ssh/%'
           OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o2.input,'{}'),'file_path') LIKE '%/.env%'
           OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o2.input,'{}'),'file_path') LIKE '%credential%')
  )
  AND t.session_id IN (
    SELECT t3.session_id FROM observations_eff o3 INNER JOIN traces t3 ON o3.trace_id=t3.id
    WHERE $__timeFilter(o3.start_time)
      AND o3.name IN ('Tool: WebFetch','Tool: WebSearch')
  )

panels.title: Bypass Users
panels.description: Distinct bypass users occurrences in the time window.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS v FROM (
  SELECT t.user_id, count(*) AS denied
  FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id=t.id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
    AND o.level='ERROR'
    AND position(coalesce(o.status_message,''),'Permission denied')>0
    AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  GROUP BY t.user_id HAVING denied >= 3
)

panels.title: Suspicious Exfiltration Pattern (sensitive read + outbound, same session)
panels.description: **High priority**: same session contains both sensitive-file reads and outbound calls. Most common exfiltration pattern.

targets.rawSql:
WITH session_signals AS (
  SELECT
    t.session_id,
    t.user_id,
    countIf(o.name = 'Tool: Read' AND
            (JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.ssh/%'
             OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.env%'
             OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%credential%'
             OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%token%'
             OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.aws/%')) AS sensitive_reads,
    countIf(o.name IN ('Tool: WebFetch', 'Tool: WebSearch')) AS outbound_calls,
    countIf(o.name = 'Tool: Bash' AND
            (positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'curl ') > 0
             OR positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'wget ') > 0)) AS bash_outbound,
    min(o.start_time) AS session_start,
    max(o.start_time) AS session_end
  FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
    AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
  GROUP BY t.session_id, t.user_id
)
SELECT
  session_id,
  user_id AS user,
  sensitive_reads,
  outbound_calls,
  bash_outbound,
  (sensitive_reads * 2 + outbound_calls + bash_outbound) AS risk_score,
  toString(session_start) AS started,
  toString(session_end) AS ended
FROM session_signals
WHERE sensitive_reads >= 1 AND (outbound_calls + bash_outbound) >= 1
ORDER BY risk_score DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Secret Pattern in Edit/Write (high precision)
panels.description: Regex match on real secret shapes: api_key, aws_creds, RSA/OpenSSH private keys, password (8+ chars), bearer tokens, OpenAI sk-, GitHub ghp_, AWS AKIA, Slack tokens & webhooks, db URLs with embedded password.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toString(o.start_time) AS at,
  t.user_id AS user,
  o.name AS tool,
  JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') AS file_path,
  multiIf(
    match(coalesce(o.input, ''), '(?i)api[_-]?key[ \t]*[=:][ \t]*"?[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}'), 'api_key',
    match(coalesce(o.input, ''), '(?i)aws[_-]?(secret|access)[_-]?key[ \t]*[=:]'), 'aws_creds',
    positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(o.input, ''), 'BEGIN RSA PRIVATE') > 0
      OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(o.input, ''), 'BEGIN OPENSSH') > 0
      OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(o.input, ''), 'BEGIN EC PRIVATE') > 0, 'private_key',
    match(coalesce(o.input, ''), '(?i)password[ \t]*[=:][ \t]*"?[A-Za-z0-9_!@#$%^&*()-]{8,}'), 'password',
    match(coalesce(o.input, ''), '(?i)bearer[ \t]+[A-Za-z0-9._-]{20,}'), 'auth_header',
    match(coalesce(o.input, ''), 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}'), 'openai_key',
    match(coalesce(o.input, ''), 'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}'), 'github_pat',
    match(coalesce(o.input, ''), 'AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}'), 'aws_access_key_id',
    match(coalesce(o.input, ''), 'xoxb-[A-Za-z0-9-]{30,}'), 'slack_token',
    match(coalesce(o.input, ''), 'https://hooks\\.slack\\.com/services/[A-Z0-9/]{30,}'), 'slack_webhook',
    match(coalesce(o.input, ''), '(?i)(postgres|mysql|mongodb)://[^\\s:@]+:[^\\s@]+@'), 'db_url_with_password',
    'other'
  ) AS kind,
  substring(coalesce(o.input, ''), 1, 200) AS sample
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND o.name IN ('Tool: Edit', 'Tool: Write', 'Tool: MultiEdit')
  AND (
    match(coalesce(o.input, ''), '(?i)api[_-]?key[ \t]*[=:][ \t]*"?[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}')
    OR match(coalesce(o.input, ''), '(?i)aws[_-]?(secret|access)[_-]?key[ \t]*[=:]')
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(o.input, ''), 'BEGIN RSA PRIVATE') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(o.input, ''), 'BEGIN OPENSSH') > 0
    OR positionCaseInsensitive(coalesce(o.input, ''), 'BEGIN EC PRIVATE') > 0
    OR match(coalesce(o.input, ''), '(?i)password[ \t]*[=:][ \t]*"?[A-Za-z0-9_!@#$%^&*()-]{8,}')
    OR match(coalesce(o.input, ''), '(?i)bearer[ \t]+[A-Za-z0-9._-]{20,}')
    OR match(coalesce(o.input, ''), 'sk-[A-Za-z0-9]{20,}')
    OR match(coalesce(o.input, ''), 'ghp_[A-Za-z0-9]{36}')
    OR match(coalesce(o.input, ''), 'AKIA[A-Z0-9]{16}')
    OR match(coalesce(o.input, ''), 'xoxb-[A-Za-z0-9-]{30,}')
    OR match(coalesce(o.input, ''), 'https://hooks\\.slack\\.com/services/[A-Z0-9/]{30,}')
    OR match(coalesce(o.input, ''), '(?i)(postgres|mysql|mongodb)://[^\\s:@]+:[^\\s@]+@')
  )
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
  AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
ORDER BY o.start_time DESC
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Privilege Bypass Attempts (>=3 Permission Denied)
panels.description: Users with >=3 'Permission denied' tool errors. Literal-case match avoids ENOACCES filesystem errors from normal shell scans.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  t.user_id AS user,
  count(*) AS denied_count,
  count(DISTINCT t.session_id) AS sessions,
  arraySlice(arrayDistinct(groupArray(coalesce(substring(o.status_message, 1, 80), ''))), 1, 5) AS sample_errors,
  toString(min(o.start_time)) AS first_attempt,
  toString(max(o.start_time)) AS last_attempt
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND o.level = 'ERROR'
  AND position(coalesce(o.status_message, ''), 'Permission denied') > 0
  AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
GROUP BY user
HAVING denied_count >= 3
ORDER BY denied_count DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Tool Sequence Patterns (consecutive calls within a session)
panels.description: Within-session tool→tool call frequency. Unexpected combos (e.g. 'Tool: Read' → 'Tool: WebFetch') are an investigation signal.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  arrayStringConcat([prev_tool, tool], ' -> ') AS sequence,
  count(*) AS occurrences
FROM (
  SELECT
    o.name AS tool,
    lagInFrame(o.name) OVER (PARTITION BY t.session_id ORDER BY o.start_time) AS prev_tool
  FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
  WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
    AND o.name LIKE 'Tool: %'
    AND t.session_id IS NOT NULL
    AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND ($__conditionalAll(t.user_id IN ($user), $user))
)
WHERE prev_tool != ''
GROUP BY sequence
ORDER BY occurrences DESC
LIMIT 30

panels.title: Cwd Activity Heatmap (directory × day)
panels.description: Activity level per cwd per day. Unfamiliar cwd suddenly busy = investigate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfDay(timestamp) AS time,
  metadata['cwd'] AS metric,
  multiIf(
    count() = 0, 'inactive',
    count() < 10, 'low',
    count() < 100, 'medium',
    count() < 500, 'high',
    'very_high'
  ) AS state
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND metadata['cwd'] != ''
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY time, metric
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: High-Risk User Score Leaderboard (LCD)
panels.description: K8s-style LCD bargauge — composite risk score, the most readable sec ranking.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  t.user_id AS user,
  countIf(o.name = 'Tool: Bash' AND positionCaseInsensitive(JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'command'), 'rm -rf') > 0) * 10 +
  countIf(o.name = 'Tool: Read' AND
          (JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.ssh/%'
           OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.env%'
           OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%credential%'
           OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%token%'
           OR JSONExtractString(coalesce(o.input, '{}'), 'file_path') LIKE '%/.aws/%')) * 8 +
  countIf(o.level = 'ERROR') * 1 AS risk_score
FROM observations_eff o INNER JOIN traces t ON o.trace_id = t.id
WHERE $__timeFilter(o.start_time)
  AND t.user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment)
GROUP BY user
HAVING risk_score > 0
ORDER BY risk_score DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: User Activity Heatmap (by day)
panels.description: Per-user per-day activity level. inactive=grey, low=blue, medium=yellow, high=orange, very_high=red. Reveals sudden bursts.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  toStartOfDay(timestamp) AS time,
  user_id AS metric,
  multiIf(
    count() = 0, 'inactive',
    count() < 5, 'low',
    count() < 50, 'medium',
    count() < 200, 'high',
    'very_high'
  ) AS state
FROM traces
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp) AND user_id IS NOT NULL
  AND $__conditionalAll(environment IN ($environment), $environment) AND $__conditionalAll(user_id IN ($user), $user)
GROUP BY time, user_id
ORDER BY time, user_id
